paragraphs.zh: Synthesis of 2-nitro-4-methylsulphonyl benzoic acid (NMSBA) of formula (III) from 2-nitro-4-methylsulfonyl toluene (NMST) of formula (IV):
paragraphs.en: Synthesis of 2-nitro-4-methylsulphonyl benzoic acid (NMSBA) of formula (III) from 2-nitro-4-methylsulfonyl toluene (NMST) of formula (IV):
paragraphs.notes: Unmarked title line of Example 1, printed immediately under the 'Example 1' heading and immediately above the reaction scheme. Note the page's own inconsistent spelling within this one sentence: 'methylsulphonyl' (ph) for NMSBA and 'methylsulfonyl' (f) for NMST. Transcribed exactly as printed, both forms kept.

paragraphs.zh: NMST (61.2g, 0.278mol), sodium hypochlorite (500ml, 0.745mol) and ruthenium oxide (1.5g, 0.011mol) were charged into a 1L round bottomed flask. This mixture was heated to reflux temperature under stirring for 6-8hours, cooled to 25-30°C and filtered. The filtrate obtained was further cooled to 5-10°C and acidified to pH <3 using concentrated hydrochloric acid(120mL, 1.23mol) to form precipitated product (NMSBA).The product obtained was filtered and dried at 50°C under reduced pressure to obtain NMSBA as light yellow solid.
paragraphs.en: NMST (61.2g, 0.278mol), sodium hypochlorite (500ml, 0.745mol) and ruthenium oxide (1.5g, 0.011mol) were charged into a 1L round bottomed flask. This mixture was heated to reflux temperature under stirring for 6-8hours, cooled to 25-30°C and filtered. The filtrate obtained was further cooled to 5-10°C and acidified to pH <3 using concentrated hydrochloric acid(120mL, 1.23mol) to form precipitated product (NMSBA).The product obtained was filtered and dried at 50°C under reduced pressure to obtain NMSBA as light yellow solid.
paragraphs.notes: Quantities transcribed exactly as printed, including the page's own spacing: 'hydrochloric acid(120mL, 1.23mol)' has no space before the bracket, '(NMSBA).The product' has no space after the full stop, and volumes are printed with mixed case ('500ml' lower-case but '120mL' with a capital L). 'pH <3' is printed with a space between pH and the less-than sign. Every digit in this paragraph was re-read at 4x magnification.

drawings.notes: One left-to-right single-arrow scheme, sitting between the Example 1 title line and paragraph [0047]. Only text on the arrow is 'Oxidant / RuO2', printed ABOVE it; there is nothing printed below the arrow. Ring positions were read off the drawn hexagon, not inferred: both rings are drawn vertex-up, the top vertex carries CH3 (left) or COOH (right), the upper-right vertex carries NO2, and the bottom vertex (para to the top one) carries the SO2 that bears the H3C written to its lower left. Every bond and label in the scheme is rendered as broken dotted ink by the bitonal scan (see brief section 9, the publication lost its greyscale), which makes the strokes ragged but did not leave any bond or position ambiguous at 4x magnification; the reaction arrow in particular looks dashed on the page but is a degraded solid line with a single solid arrowhead, recorded as solid. The formula labels read 'Formula IV' and 'Formula III'; the roman numerals were checked at 4x because the degraded ink makes III and IV easy to confuse.

discrepancies.what: The scheme names the oxidant only generically while the prose names a specific one.
discrepancies.drawing_says: 'Oxidant / RuO2' above the arrow; the actual oxidant is left unnamed and only the ruthenium catalyst is spelled out.
discrepancies.text_says: [0047] charges 'sodium hypochlorite (500ml, 0.745mol)' as the oxidant together with 'ruthenium oxide (1.5g, 0.011mol)'.

discrepancies.what: The acidification step of the written procedure has no counterpart on the drawing.
discrepancies.drawing_says: A single arrow from Formula IV to Formula III carrying only 'Oxidant / RuO2'; no acid, no reflux, no temperature and no work-up is drawn.
discrepancies.text_says: [0047] additionally requires reflux for 6-8hours, cooling to 25-30°C, filtration, cooling to 5-10°C and acidification to pH <3 with concentrated hydrochloric acid(120mL, 1.23mol) before NMSBA precipitates.

discrepancies.what: Example 1 and Example 2 are given identical titles and identical chemistry, differing only in scale.
discrepancies.drawing_says: One scheme is drawn, under Example 1 only; Example 2 has no scheme of its own on this page.
discrepancies.text_says: The Example 2 title line is character-for-character identical to the Example 1 title line, and [0048] repeats the same three charges (NMST, sodium hypochlorite, ruthenium oxide) at roughly one twelfth the scale.
